description: This is a Java Swing UI component class named TableEditorPane responsible for initializing and displaying an ECU editor interface within a panel. It interacts with protocol and configuration classes to load and display ECU configuration images.

classes.name: TableEditorPane
classes.description: A Swing JPanel subclass that initializes and displays an ECU configuration editor, loading ECU images if available and handling UI updates.

methods.name: TableEditorPane
methods.description: Constructor that sets up the panel layout and shows a loading message.

methods.name: showContent
methods.description: Loads ECU configuration data and displays the editor UI; checks for definition files, retrieves ECU images, and handles exceptions.
